newsitem.title: USA: Education Alternatives Inc Q4 June 30 loss.
newsitem.headline: Education Alternatives Inc Q4 June 30 loss.

text.p: NOTE: Company said Q4 and FY1996 operating results hurt by cancellation of Hartford, Conn., and Baltimore, Md., management and consulting contracts during year.

NOTE: Fiscal 1996 results include charges of $6.3 million to cover costs incurred but not yet reimbursed under Hartford contract and shutdown costs associated with cancellation of Baltimore and Hartford contracts.
Fourth quarter and fiscal 1995 results included charge of $5.5 million related to costs incurred by not yet reimbursed under Hartford contract.

In Q4 1996, company reached partial settlement with Hartford on amounts owed to it under school management contract. Under this settlement, it received $3.1 million for computers installed and capital improvements made to schools.
Q4 1996 also includes charge of $3.4 million for permanent impairment of investment portfolio and related decision to liquidate investments in fiscal 1997.
